name: Gà nướng lu
summary: Chicken roasted in a lu at Lẩu gà lá é 668 on Chu Văn An. Order it alongside the hotpot.
origin: Lẩu gà lá é 668 also serves gà nướng lu.
howToEat: Have the roast at the same door as the hotpot.
where: Lẩu gà lá é 668, 2B Chu Văn An.
priceBand: Check on arrival. The door's hotpot is 20,000–100,000 VND a person (food-tour note).
